title: From 5 stars to 3 stars
body: The reading resources and else are great. But when it really comes to tracking your habit really doesn’t work. You cannot log a habit without the compact view. And you are so limited to edit it and navigate around it that a book and pen make the job better. 1 Star for reading resources, 1 star for Atomic Habits and 1 star for James Clear. Try to make the habits more editable, add more sooner and definitely for me will be back at 5 stars. Aim to be like Duolingo! Although you can’t be like Duo. None of us can. :(
author: dp_d-doo
